```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# Définir p_mois_courant à partir du paramètre
p_mois_courant <- params$p_mois_courant
langue <- params$langue
code_ville <- params$code_ville

# Exécuter le script
source("../Sous_programmes/retrouver_donnees.R", local = TRUE)


# Appeler la fonction
resultat <- retrouver_donnees(p_mois_courant,code_ville,langue)
```
```{r}
#| echo: false
library(flextable)
library(officer)

data.frame(
  col1 = paste0("Indice des prix à la consommation - ", resultat$p00),
  col2 = paste0(
  str_to_upper(str_sub(resultat$ville, 1, 1)),
  str_sub(resultat$ville, 2)
  )
) |>
  flextable() |>
  delete_part(part = "header") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed", width = 1) |>
  width(j = 1, width = 6.30) |>
  width(j = 2, width = 1.575) |>
  border_remove() |>
  border(j = 1, border.bottom = fp_border(color = "#F8A180", width = 1.5)) |>
  border(j = 2, border.bottom = fp_border(color = "#F8A180", width = 1.5)) |>
  bg(j = 2, bg = "#F8A180") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "body") |>
  bold(part = "body") |>
  color(color = "#8D4354", part = "body") |>
  align(j = 2, align = "center")
```
